name: Momentum tilt
notes: Trades from 2021 (~5 years). Factor-tilt book blending core US equity (SPY), growth/tech (QQQ), technology (XLK) and financials (XLF), rebalanced quarterly to let momentum run. Linked to the official momentum-tilt and sector-tilt sleeves.
objective: Capture momentum in growth/tech and financials against a core US equity position.
constraints: Factor-tilt ETFs; quarterly rebalance; SPY benchmark.
